You need to be Citizen (Lv 10 - 15) to get employed. Chat more in #general to level up faster!
Quitting a job triggers a 48-hour cooldown before you can work again. Choose your job wisely!
Each job has its own level tree. Complete bounties to earn XP and get promoted!
Lawyers level up into Judges. Only Judges are eligible to become Chief Justice!
The Chief Justice is elected by the Bar Club — the club of Lawyers and Judges.
Use /issue to post a bounty for a specific job. Employees will come to you!
Bounties auto-complete after 48 hours if the customer doesn't confirm payment. Get your work done on time!
Imprisoned citizens cannot claim bounties. Stay out of trouble!
A tax is deducted from every bounty payment and goes to the National Treasury. The Finance Minister manages it.
You can negotiate the prize on a bounty with the customer in your private bounty channel.
If a customer declines your completion, you can dispute the bounty — it goes straight to the Supreme Court!
Your wallet holds your spendable coins. Deposited coins are stored separately in the bank.
Use /send to transfer coins to another citizen. Note that all transfers are taxed!
The National Treasury is funded by taxes and fines. Only the Finance Minister can spend it — after a Money Bill is passed in Lok Sabha!
Deposited coins earn interest over time. The longer you wait to withdraw, the more you earn!
Interest resets every time you make a new deposit. Plan your deposits carefully!
Your CIBIL score determines how much you can borrow from the bank. Keep it above 750 for the best loan terms.
Repaying your loan on time gives you +50 CIBIL points. Missing the deadline costs you 100 points!
If your CIBIL score is too low for a bank loan, contact a Banker — they can lend you coins personally.
Overdue loans are auto-deducted from your wallet whenever you earn money. Don't ignore them!
You need to be Citizen (Lv 25 - 30) to contest elections. Keep chatting to reach that level!
You need to be Citizen (Lv 35 - 40) to form a political party.
Party leaders register on behalf of their entire party in elections. Votes go to the party, not individuals!
Independent candidates can contest elections without a party — but parties are stronger in numbers!
You can change your vote anytime before the election ends. No pressure!
Cabinet elections choose 7 ministers. The elected ministers then vote among themselves for the Speaker.
By-elections are held when a minister's seat becomes vacant mid-term.
The Speaker convenes the Lok Sabha but is not a Cabinet minister.
Clubs can be converted into political parties if the Club President and majority of members agree. File a petition to get started!
Club Presidents are elected by club members. You need to be Citizen (Lv 25 - 30) to contest a club election.
Want a new club? File a petition in #petitions. The Chief Justice decides!
The Lok Sabha passes bills by majority vote. The President can veto, but cannot make changes unilaterally!
The Supreme Court handles petitions, complaints and PILs. File in #petitions. The Chief Justice's verdict is final — even the President cannot overturn it!
You can represent yourself in the Supreme Court or hire an Attorney to argue your case.
Attorneys represent clients in the Supreme Court. Hire one in #bots using /issue!
Reporters cover major server events in #doordarshan. Hire one to uncover hidden truths!
Psychiatrists are available for therapy and venting sessions. Hire one using /issue!
Bankers manage loan rates and can personally lend you coins beyond your CIBIL limit.
Tax rate is set by the Finance Minister, Prime Minister, Home Minister or President using /config tax.
Setting your profile to private hides it from other citizens. Tax authorities can still view it though!
Your profile shows your current job, level, XP, wallet balance and bounties completed. Use /profile to check!
The leaderboard tracks lifetime earnings, not current wallet balance. Complete more bounties to climb it!
Fines are issued by the Chief Justice. Under the Nyaya Sanhita, fines kick in after 5 warnings.
The Nyaya Sanhita: 5 warnings → fine, 10 → 24hr timeout, 15 → 48hr imprisonment, 25 → kick, 30+ → ban.
An imprisoned citizen can still access #petitions to appeal their case.
Sending invite links gets you kicked instantly. No exceptions!
Spamming outside #spam earns you a 1-hour timeout. Keep it in #spam!
NSFW content outside #nsfw is worth 6 hours of timeout. Use the right channels!
Chat more in #general to level up faster with @Atlas. Higher levels unlock jobs, elections and more!
Get 5 stars on your message to be featured in #starboard. Post something worthy!
Booster roles: Ambani for single boost, Adani for double boost. Boosters keep this server alive!
Check #freebies for free games posted by @EpicFreeGames. Always keep an eye out!
Register your birthday on @BirthdayBot to get the Birthday role and a special shoutout in #janmotsav-bhavan!
The External Affairs Minister manages partnerships and immigration. Want to partner with us? Reach out to them!
The Cultural Minister organises server events. Keep an eye on #events for upcoming activities!
Arthashastra is the official economy bot of Sarkari Adda. Use /profile to see your citizen stats!
